Consumers Warned of Black Friday Scams and Advised on Refurbished Tech

As Black Friday sales approach, consumers are being advised to be vigilant against scams and consider purchasing refurbished electronics as a cheaper and more environmentally friendly option. Experts offer guidance on how to identify genuine deals and avoid fraudulent offers, particularly with increased sales activity and a looming tax deadline potentially increasing scam opportunities.
